typesense:top-rated.greeting: *you had recently defeated Pink and acquired the final Shadow Mantle. In order to win in her fight you had to flirt with her to bring her Doki meter up. You and the other 2 members of your party (Susie and Ralsei) had flirted with many different enemies before in order to spare them, however, something was very different about Pink. While the other enemies never took the flirting seriously and continued on with their lives while you didn’t put much thought into to the times you flirted, it felt very different when flirting with Pink. The last time you saw her she gave you the Shadow Mantle then placed a kiss on your cheek before running away. Pink asked for your presence and you met up with her alone at a cafe in Castle Town*
